judged_text: The permission check binds isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner with && while the accepted feature intent (and the variable name isTeamAdminOrOwner) is OR, so the team-admin/owner grant is unreachable code. Team admins and team owners can never add guests to team-event bookings unless they happen to also be the organizer or an attendee; the silently narrowed permission model means the shipped feature only works for the booking organizer and existing attendees, which is not the objective the feature was accepted under.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the variable `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed using `&&`: `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. This requires a user to be both a team admin and a team owner to pass, which contradicts the variable name and expected "admin OR owner" semantics. As a result, team admins (only) or team owners (only) will fail the permission gate unless they are also the organizer or an attendee, narrowing access in a way directly caused by this diff.
